rows.note: Use 新聞 for reports about current events in the media.

example.english: I watched the news this morning and only then learned about that fire.
example.traditional: 我朝早睇咗新聞，先知嗰單火災。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 tai2 zo2 san1 man4 sin1 zi1 go2 daan1 fo2 zoi1

rows.note: Use 消息 as the all-purpose noun for new information or an update about a particular matter.

example.english: Have you received any news from that company?
example.traditional: 你有冇收到間公司嗰邊嘅消息？
example.jyutping: nei5 jau5 mou5 sau1 dou2 gaan1 gung1 si1 go2 bin1 ge3 siu1 sik1
